notes.title: Brave Hero Yuusha EX v1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
Hello all!

Brave Hero Yuusha EX has been updated to v1.1.3. Due to reports of crashes likely caused by font rendering, the game's font has been replaced with a new font that should help alleviate this problem. This change will also help the game run a bit more smoothly overall.

Version v1.1.2 will still be available to download for players who prefer the old font style and have not experienced any crashes. To revert to v1.1.2 on Steam, right-click Brave Hero Yuusha EX in your Steam library, choose "Betas" and choose "Previous - v1.1.2".

Please let me know if there are any questions or concerns!

- Sgt M, Lead Developer

notes.title: Update: v1.1.2
notes.content:
Brave Hero Yuusha EX has been updated to v1.1.2! This is a minor update that makes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed the Hero displaying the wrong sprite during one of the final story scenes.
[*] Updated the descriptions of the skills Pain and Agony to better reflect what they do.
[*] Minor spelling fixes.
[*] Minor map fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Brave Hero Yuusha EX has been updated to Version 1.1.1. This is a minor update that makes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Brave Mode can now be toggled on and off at any time in the System menu.
[*]Made some of the battle-relevant text during the final boss battle more clear.
[*]Minor text fixes for various inventory items.
[*]Verbatim's name has finally been fixed, nearly two years later.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Hey all! Today is the first anniversary of Brave Hero Yuusha EX's release! And with it comes the v1.1.0 update. This version adds the following changes

- Level Cap raised to 40.
- Upon completing the Mitten tournament in Chapter EX, a special visitor will be waiting for you.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 update
notes.content:
Brave Hero Yuusha EX has been updated to v1.0.4. This is a minor patch that (hopefully) addresses Steam Achievements not unlocking correctly for some players, particularly the achievement for finishing Chapter 3.

Achievements can now also be synced at any time by talking to Vertabim in Landia.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Brave Hero Yuusha EX has been updated to v.1.0.3! 

This patch adds the option to turn off battle animations in the System menu and fixes a few minor spelling errors.

That's about it!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 update
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2 is now live! This is a minor patch that makes the following changes:

[list]
[*] The appearance select screen has been updated, and now includes character portraits.
[*] Minor text fixes and changes.
[*] Fixed the Lavatate Band treasure chest that still appeared to be closed after it is opened.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Brave Hero Yuusha EX has been updated to version 1.0.1! This fixes a few minor issues listed below:

[list]
[*] Dung Bombles no longer explode if a Racket Cactus hasn't summoned them yet.
[*] Dung Bombles and related monsters now have a chance to perform an alternate kind of explosion as originally intended.
[*] A tutorial in the beginning dungeon now informs you that F12 resets the game. (Really, don't take screenshots with F12. I beg of you.)
[*] Minor text fixes.
[*] Minor mapping fixes.
[/list]
